meta_description:
18K likes, 266 comments - abybaig on August 19, 2026: "Dear Photography,

It’s been 13 years since you chose me, and it’s been an honour serving you ❤️

You’ve seen every version of me, my sleepless nights, my tears, my triumphs, loneliness, my hunger for stories, and the quiet moments no one ever saw.. You’ve seen me change, lose, grow, and find pieces of myself along the way. 

Thank you for staying through it all, for giving meaning to my journey, and for becoming a part of who I am.

Happy World Photography Day to y’all..

Keep creating, Keep seeing, Keep your originality alive ❤️📸

.
.
.
.
.

#abybaig
Artist, Photographer, Journey, Photography, Life, Story, Document, Travel, Wander, Creative, Vision, Solitude, Time, Memory, Becoming".
